title: What cannot be cut
subtitle: Limits and leftover rules
text:
Most full, solid, basic blocks can be cut, including modded ones. Chests, furnaces, machines and other blocks with inventories or special behaviour cannot.

Concrete powder cannot be cut. Bedrock, infested blocks and most redstone and utility blocks cannot be cut either. Glass and stained glass can be cut.

steps.title: Falling blocks
steps.text: Sand and gravel pieces stay where you place them. They do not fall.

steps.title: No reassembly
steps.text: You cannot craft pieces back into a full block. Once a block is cut, it stays as pieces.

steps.title: Datapacks
steps.text: Datapacks can change what is allowed with the smolblocks:cuttable, smolblocks:uncuttable and smolblocks:needs_diamond_saw tags.
